Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionEvery Second Counts. History Is Inevitable. April 14, 1912. The final night of the RMS Titanic. You are a private investigator aboard the world’s most famous ocean liner. What begins as a routine voyage soon becomes something far darker: a suspicious death, hidden clues, locked rooms, restricted decks, and a mystery buried deep within the ship. Explore the Titanic before disaster strikes. Question passengers, search cabins, uncover secrets, and follow a trail that leads from the elegance of First Class to the shadowed lower decks below. But as the truth begins to surface, so does the danger. And then the iceberg hits. What was once an investigation becomes a desperate fight for survival as freezing water floods the ship, corridors tilt, lights fail, and panic spreads across the decks. Every choice matters. Every second counts. The ship will sink. What you discover — and who you save — is up to you. KEY FEATURES: Explore the Titanic Before and During the Disaster Walk through richly detailed areas of the ship, from luxurious public rooms to restricted service corridors, cargo spaces, machinery areas, and lifeboat decks. Investigate a Dark Mystery Search crime scenes, collect evidence, question passengers, and uncover hidden connections before the final night arrives. Puzzle and Lock Interaction Solve environmental puzzles, open locked doors, decode clues, and use tools to access restricted areas. Stealth and Tension Enter forbidden sections of the ship, avoid dangerous enemies, and uncover secrets others want buried. Dynamic Sinking Gameplay Experience rising water, tilting decks, blocked paths, failing lights, and changing environments as Titanic succumbs to the Atlantic. Survival Mechanics Manage cold, stamina, blocked routes, and physical hazards while trying to reach safety. Moral Choices and Multiple Endings In the final moments, decide what matters most: justice, love, or saving as many lives as possible. Historical Atmosphere Meet passengers and crew inspired by real Titanic history, and witness moments of human courage, fear, and sacrifice during the final hours. Do you have what it takes to survive the most famous shipwreck in history? Or will you become another soul claimed by the icy depths? The clock is ticking. The water is rising. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionVoltaire: The Vegan Vampire is an action-farming-roguelite set in Transylvania, the homeland of Dracula and his rebellious lastborn son, Voltaire. An epiphany results in a change of heart for the young vampire: abandoning blood in favor of a plant-based diet out of spite to prove to his father that neck-biting is not the only way for vampires to thrive. The Elder Vampire doesn't take kindly to such ideas, but with the help of uncle(s) Frank and Stein, Voltaire slips away from his father’s gaze. Once on his own, he embarks on a creepy, cute odyssey full of veggie recipes, a plant-based lifestyle, and hand-drawn art celebrating the gloriously macabre! Grow Stronger - Farm during the day with magical seeds to cultivate crops and provide Voltaire with sweet nourishment in his quest to become the world's first vegan vampire! - Expand the farm and territory and conquer numerous biomes on Voltaire’s path to chlorophyll-based power. - Be wary once night begins to fall. Dracula will send his minions to ruin Voltaire’s crops and make him return to a “proper,” red-blooded diet. Defy Your Elders - Defend the crops against Dracula’s army of ghoulish minions, hell-bent on denying Voltaire his hard-earned oatmeal shake. - Embrace vampiric dark powers to defeat the bosses sent by Dracula when his lesser minions fail. - Overcome Dracula’s power and inherit his reign through much greener means. Veggie Power - Evolve Voltaire into higher vampiric forms thanks to his dietary plan filled with many new abilities. - Complete bounties for uncle(s) Frank and Stein, while defeating Transylvania's mythical creatures and reap the rewards to continue sowing. - Prevail over every metaphorical pickle Voltaire may find himself in or risk the temptation of his bloodlust munching on a neck or two. Don't sweat it. There is always a chance to try dieting again, this time with new knowledge and abilities!Show morePublished byJanduSoftDeveloped byDigitality GamesRelease date10/7/2026Play withXBOX Series X|SPCHandheldCapabilitiesXbox local multiplayer (2-4)4K Ultra HDSingle playerShared/split screenOptimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud savesXbox Play Anywhere XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
